records.title: Native analytic torus decoder
records.summary: Adds opt-in typed ACIS700 ring-torus surface decoding with finite, radius, frame and token guards; preserves existing graph traversal and rigid-world mapping.

records.title: Torus decoder tests
records.summary: Four executed tests cover malformed tokens, numerical/frame guards, rigid mapping, explicit option enforcement and decoding of the retained four-patch native torus.

records.title: Observed native torus binary
records.summary: Actual reopened native SAB supplied typed surface slot evidence, four surface patches and seam-point topology for generic reader implementation.

records.title: acadrust SAT torus surface types
records.summary: Published SAT record accessors describe centre, normal and radius order; Luna inspected the source page. SAB typed slots were independently inspected from retained binary.

records.title: acadrust SAT torus writer
records.summary: Published writer emits centre, normal, major/minor radii and reference direction in the SAT representation. Luna inspected the page; no code copied.

records.title: acadrust license metadata
records.summary: Published crate metadata declares MPL-2.0; source review supplies attribution for format research.
